info.title: AutoFi API
info.description:
# Introduction
 Welcome to the AutoFi REST API. Our API has predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepts JSON-encoded request bodies, returns JSON-encoded responses, and uses standard HTTP response codes, authentication, and verbs.

# HTTP Requests
### Environments
Environment | URL
----------------|-------------
Test Sandbox | https://api-uat.autofi.com
Production | https://api.autofi.com

### Request Headers

The `Content-Type` header for `POST` and `PUT` requests should be set to `application/json` unless otherwise noted.

Header | Value
----------------|-------------
Content-Type | application/json

### Response Headers
Header | Value
----------------|-------------
X-RateLimit-Limit | Request quota
X-RateLimit-Reset | UNIX timestamp the request quota will be reset after exceeding it
X-RateLimit-Remaining | Remaining requests in quota
Retry-After | Time in seconds to retry after
X-Response-Time | The time in milliseconds it took to respond to the request

# HTTP Responses
AutoFi uses standard HTTP response codes to indicate the success or failure of an API request. 

## Successful requests
HTTP requests that are successfully processed returns `2xx` status codes.

| Status code | Description |
| -- | -- |
| **200 OK** | The request was successfully processed and requested content is returned in the response body. |
| **201 Created** | The request was successfully processed and a new resource was created. |
| **204 No Content** | The request was successfully processed and the response body has no content. |

## Failed Requests
HTTP requests that are not successfully processed, due to a client or server error, returns `4xx` or `5xx` status codes respectively.

### HTTP 4XX status codes
| Status code | Description 
| -- | -- |
| **400 Bad Request** | The request cannot be processed. Typically due to a malformed payload.
| **401 Unauthorized** | The request has invalid credentials (token).
| **403 Forbidden** | The request has insufficient privileges.
| **404 Not Found** | The requested resource could not be found.
| **405 Method Not Allowed** | The API does not allow this method.
| **415 Unsupported Media Type** | The payload format is not supported. [AutoFi request headers](#request-headers).
| **429 Too Many Requests** | There were too many request in a given amount of time.

### Error response definition
Most types of errors have the following structure:
| field | Description 
| --- | --- 
| code | reference to the status code of the response
| message | defines the error type 
| errors | contains an array of objects with the description for an error or multiple errors generated.

### Error Types

`4xx` Errors can be thrown for different reasons. The following section describes common shapes for the error objects returned.

#### Validation Errors
Validation errors return a `400` status code indicating a `Bad Request`.

| Parameter type | Description 
| --- | --- 
| string | `dob`, `email`, `phone`, etc., have formats and possibly character restrictions which must be observed. e.g. `phone` must be a 10 character long string that contains only numbers.
| number | `apr`, `downPayment`, `term`, etc., have range requirements which must be observed. e.g. `apr` must be a number between [0...1]. 
| integer | `timeInMonths`, `monthlyPayment`, `year`, etc., have range requirements which must be observed.  


> #### Example Response `400 Bad Request`
>  ```json
> {
>   "code": 400,
>   "message": "Validation Error",
>   "errors": [
>       {
>         "description": "Required field \"applicant\" was not provided."
>       },
>       {
>         "description": "Field \"cosigner.email\" is invalid: io."
>       }
>   ]
> }
>  ```


#### Authorization Errors
Authorization errors return a `401` status code indicating a `Unauthorized`.
Most endpoints will return some of the following errors in case of an invalid
(malformed or expired) or absent authorization token, indicating that a new 
token must be requested.

> #### Example Response `401 `
>  ```json
> {
>     "error": "UnauthorizedError: invalid token"
> }
>  ```
>  ```json
> {
>     "error": "UnauthorizedError: No authorization token was found"
> }
>  ```
>  ```json
> {
>     "error": "UnauthorizedError: Format is Authorization: Bearer [token]"
> }
>  ```
>  ```json
> {
>     "error": "UnauthorizedError: jwt malformed"
> }
>  ```

#### Not Found Errors
Not Found errors return a `404` status code indicating a `Not Found`.

> #### Example Response `404 Not found`
>  ```json
> {
>     "error": "Error: Not Found"
> }
>  ```

#### Rate Limiting
If the server is receiving an excessive amount of requests from a 
particular user, it may return errors with a `429` status code 
indicating `Too many requests`.

> #### Example Response `429 Too many requests`
>  ```json
> {
>   "code": 429,
>   "message": "Account limit exceeded.",
> }
>  ```


### HTTP 5XX status codes
| Http Status | Description |
| -- | -- |
| **500 Internal Server Error** | An unexpected error occurred, preventing successfully processing the request. |
| **503 Service Unavailable** | An AutoFi service is unavailable, preventing successfully processing the request. |   

> See the [Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP)](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7231) or the [MDN docs](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Status) for more details.

### Error Type

#### 503 Service Unavailable
Service unavailable error is returned when our servers is not available to process and return a response.

> #### Example Response `503 service unavailable`
>  ```json
> {
>   "code": 503,
>   "message": "Service Unavailable",
>   "errors": [
>       {
>         "description": "Service Unavailable"
>       },
>   ]
> }
>  ```

Authenticate with your account's API client credentials to retrieve an access token.

The access token is required to authorize API requests.

expires_in.description: number of `seconds` after token issuance the token expires in

post.description: You can provide a callback URL through the `callbackURL` property. See the callbacks section below for more information.

AutoFi REST APIs use callbacks for event notifications, such as lender decisions when applying for credit. 
Callbacks are outbound API calls that notify you when an event has occurred.  Note: Callbacks do not 
have a re-try function.

### How to use

On the AutoFi Create Loan Application you can provide the `callbackUrl` property with a URL value.  AutoFi will send 
event notifications to that URL.

### Messages

A JSON notification will be triggered when a new event takes place. For example, an event will trigger a notification
when a loan application has been approved or declined by a lender. The callback response body contains the same 
information as returned by the [GET Loan Application](#tag/Loan-Applications/paths/~1v1~1loan-application~1{loanApplicationId}/get) 
endpoint.

### Event triggers

Enum: `"ACCEPTED"` `"APPROVED"` `"BEGAN_APPLICATION"` `"DECLINED"`  `"ERROR"` `"FI_COMPLETED"` `"PENDING"` `"SUBMITTED"`

callbackUrl.description: A valid URL to receive responses when there is a change in state.

code.description: Identification assigned to dealer by AutoFi.

apr.description: Annual percentage rate in decimals e.g. if the apr is 2% this should be 0.02

isSubvented.description: Indicates that the rate in this offer contains a subvented or special rate. This influences rules relating to markup and rebate compatibility. This only affects the offer if there is an `apr` specified.

taxRate.description: Required if `requestedOfferType` is `LEASE`. Must not be greater than 1. Used to calculate a number of tax values related to a lease.

payoff.description: The payoff amount the customer needs to pay to satisfy the terms of their vehicle loan.

bookoutValue.description: Bookout value to override bookout calculation if `age` is `USED` or `CPO`.

modelCode.description: The code for the model provided by the manufacturer. This field is optional but strongly recommended for new vehicles and lease applications since it greatly improves deal accuracy, e.g. determining the correct rebates.

trim.description: Vehicle trim. This field is optional but strongly recommended for lease applications since it greatly improves deal accuracy, e.g. determining the correct rebates.

get.description: Collection of resources in external systems that are associated with the loan application. External resources are updated with information about the deal during the loan application process. After the external system has been updated, external resources are available in the response, grouped by the external system type and then by the provider of each system. Currently Dealer Management Systems (DMS) are the only available external system type and the only provider is for the CDK DMS. This endpoint is still `experimental` and can change in the future.

oemSalesCodes.description: External dealer code assigned by the OEM.

post.description: Create a new Dealmaker loan application.

Create a new Dealmaker loan application that starts at the credit application. Use this endpoint when the consumer has already selected a vehicle and is ready to apply for credit. NOTE: Only retail finance is currently supported. This is experimental and can change in the future.

Dealmaker loan applications utilize the same callbacks sent by the Create Loan Application endpoint.

AutoFi REST APIs use callbacks for event notifications, such as lender decisions when applying for credit. 
Callbacks are outbound API calls that notify you when an event has occurred.  Note: Callbacks do not 
have a re-try function.

### How to use

On the AutoFi Create Loan Application you can provide the `callbackUrl` property with a URL value.  AutoFi will send 
event notifications to that URL.

### Messages

A JSON notification will be triggered when a new event takes place. For example, an event will trigger a notification
when a loan application has been approved or declined by a lender. The callback response body contains the same 
information as returned by the [GET Loan Application](#tag/Loan-Applications/paths/~1v1~1loan-application~1{loanApplicationId}/get) 
endpoint.

### Event triggers

Enum: `"ACCEPTED"` `"APPROVED"` `"BEGAN_APPLICATION"` `"DECLINED"`  `"ERROR"` `"FI_COMPLETED"` `"PENDING"` `"SUBMITTED"`
Use this endpoint to calculate estimated payments for a `cash` car deal.
Use this endpoint to calculate estimated payments for a `finance` car deal.
Use this endpoint to calculate estimated payments for a `lease` car deal.

Prequalification can be utilized to help identify how much the user can afford. 
This endpoint provides the maximum monthly payment, maximum loan amount, and a credit score range.

maxLoanAmount.description: The maximum loan that the applicant can afford.

maxMonthlyPayment.description: The maximum monthly payment that the applicant can afford.

ficoRange.description: Deprecated in favor of appropriately named `creditScoreRange` field.

LoanApplicationIdParam.name: loanApplicationId
LoanApplicationIdParam.description: The `loanApplicationId` in the response when the loan application was created.

bearerAuth.description: Get access to data while protecting your account credentials.

Dealer.description: Describes the dealer the vehicle to be financed is associated with

referenceId.description: Unique identifier for `dealer` in your system. Required for creating/updating a dealer.

state.description: Two character code for state (US) or province (Canada).

logoUrl.description: A valid url to display the dealer's logo.

setfDealerNumber.description: SETF's identification number for the dealer. To be used when submitting the application.

specialPlacement.description: Only used for lease fees. Defaults to NONE

method.description: Should the price be marked up or down.

lender.description: Lender code this markup applies to.

amount.description: Amount in decimals e.g. if the amount is 5% this should be 0.05.

isTaxable.description:
Default: `false`
Applies only when requested offerType is `FINANCE`.

AuthorizationError.description: Access token is missing or invalid

ApplicantBaseNameInput.title: Name
ApplicantBaseNameInput.description: Names must start with one or more alphanumeric characters, and may be followed by one special character as long as that special character is followed by one or more alphanumeric characters. A name may also end with a period.

AddressResidenceType.description:
The type of residence at this address.

Both `BUYING` and `RENT` indicate the applicant has a monthly mortgage or rent payment. When either of these two
`residenceType` values are provided, the `residenceMonthlyPayment` field is required and must be a positive integer.

For all other `residenceType` values, if the `residenceMonthlyPayment` field is provided, it is ignored and
**NOT** submitted to lenders. All other `address` fields are the same regardless of `residenceType`.

`BUYING`: The applicant has monthly mortgage payments.

`MOBILE`: The applicant does not have a monthly payment.
    
`OTHER`: The applicant does not have a monthly payment.

`OWN`: The applicant does not have a monthly payment because they own their home outright.

`RELATIVES`: The applicant does not have a monthly payment.

`RENT`: The applicant has monthly rent payments.

residenceMonthlyPayment.description: The monthly mortgage or rent payment. Required when `residenceType` is `BUYING` or `RENT` and must be a positive integer. For all other `residenceType` values, this field should be omitted.

residenceTimeInMonths.description:
The number of months living at this address. If less than 24 please include `previousAddress`. 

__Note:__ An input of 0 will be rounded up to 1 month.

EmailInput.title: Email
EmailInput.description: An email is an ASCII string separated into two parts by the @ symbol (local_part@domain). The local_part may contain uppercase (A-Z) and lowercase (a-z) ASCII characters, digits (0-9), special characters (+, -, _, !, #, $, %, &, , *, /, =, ?, ^, `, {, |, }, ~) and the . character. The domain part of an email may contain letters, digits, hyphens and periods. The top level domain (TLD) portion of the domain must also be published by IANA to be considered valid. See https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc2822#section-3.4.1 for more information.

MaritalStatus.description: Marital status. Note: This field is optional, but it is recommended if the applicant or the dealer is in Wisconsin.

EducationLevel.description: Education level. Note: This field is optional, but it is required to receive a decision for New Toyota and Lexus vehicles.

employerName.description: Name of employer. _Required if `employmentStatus` is "EMPLOYED", "STUDENT", "OTHER" or "SELF_EMPLOYED"._

timeInMonths.description: Number of months working for this employer.  If less than 24 please include `previousEmployment`.

employerPhone.description: A valid phone number. _Required if `employmentStatus` is "EMPLOYED"._

source.description:
e.g.

- Aid for Dependent Children
- Child Support
- Cost of Living Allowance (COLA)
- Disability
- Family Subsistence Supplemental Allowance (FSSA)
- Housing Allowances
- Military Basic Allowance for Subsistence (BAS)
- Municipal Bond Interest
- Other Non-Taxable Sources of Income
- Other
- Public Assistance
- Railroad Pension
- Second Employer
- Social Security Benefits
- Tips
- Workman's Compensation

allOf.description:
Applicant previous residence information. Recommended when the applicant has lived at the current
address for less than 2 years.

ssn.description: Social Security Number / ITIN in US. Note: The application is only submitted to lenders that support ITIN.

timeInMonths.description: Number of months working for this employer.

dob.description: Date of Birth `YYYY-MM-DD`. Must be older than 18 and younger than 120.

incomeReported.description: Total gross monthly income from employment and other sources. _Deprecated - Use `employmentIncome` and `otherIncome` fields instead._

employmentIncome.description: Gross monthly income from employment. _Required if `employmentStatus` is "EMPLOYED", "SELF_EMPLOYED" or "MILITARY"._

otherIncome.description: Monthly income from sources other than employment.

creditScore.description:
Credit score. When provided must be a number between 300 and 999 or `null` to indicate that no credit score
is available.

This field has been **deprecated** and will be removed in a future version. Please update your queries accordingly.

Relationship.description: The cosigner's relationship with the primary applicant. Use `PARENT` when the cosigner is the applicant's parent. Use `RESIDESWITH` when there is no familial relationship but the applicant and cosigner live together.

allOf.description:
Cosigner previous residence information. Recommended when the cosigner has lived at the current
address for less than 2 years.

ssn.description: Social Security Number / ITIN in US. Note: The application is only submitted to lenders that support ITIN.

dob.description: Date of Birth `YYYY-MM-DD`. Must be older than 18 and younger than 120.

incomeReported.description: Total gross monthly income from employment and other sources. _Deprecated - Use `employmentIncome` and `otherIncome` fields instead._

employmentIncome.description: Gross monthly income from employment. _Required if `employmentStatus` is "EMPLOYED", "SELF_EMPLOYED" or "MILITARY"._

otherIncome.description: Monthly income from sources other than employment.

code.description: Identification assigned to dealer by AutoFi. Created via the `POST /dealer` endpoint (if submitting applications for multiple dealers) or will be provided by AutoFi.

middleman.description: Portal used to submit the credit applications to the lenders.

middlemanId.description: The dealer id used in the middleman portal on whose behalf the application will be submitted to the lender.

state.description: The dealer's state which the book values for collateral valuation are based on.

FeeCodeInput.description: Default is `OTHER`. Note: The `SHIPPING_FEE` is added to the vehicle's sales price when submitted to the middleman.

name.description: The name of the fee. This fee varies per application and is different from dealer fees that are constant across all applications.

feePlacement.description: Applies only when `requestedOfferType` is  "LEASE". Defaults to `GROSS_CAP`. `GROSS_CAP` means that the fee will be added to the Gross Capitalization Cost of the lease. `DUE_AT_SIGNING` means that the fee will be added to the Due at Signing Calculation and thus deducted from the down payment.

schemas-FeeCodeInput.description:
Default is `OTHER`.
Note: The `SHIPPING_FEE` is added to the vehicle's sales price when submitted to the middleman.
All fee types will be taxable based upon the appropriate jurisdiction with the exception of `OTHER`.

Apr.description: Annual percentage rate in decimals e.g. if the apr is 2% this should be 0.02

DownPayment.title: Down Payment
DownPayment.description: Amount the consumer is putting down towards the vehicle.

IncentiveOption.title: Incentive Option
IncentiveOption.description: The type of incentive the consumer is looking for.

IsSubvented.description: Indicates that the rate in this offer contains a subvented or special rate. This influences rules relating to markup and rebate compatibility.

CreditOfferType.title: Offer Type
CreditOfferType.description: How the customer is financing the vehicle - `FINANCE` or `LEASE`.

annualMileage.description: Miles the consumer would prefer when leasing a vehicle

tax.description:
Tax amount for the product. Defaults to 0.  
**Notes:** Does not include vehicle taxes.  
  For vehicle specific taxes see `appliedTaxes.amount`.  
  For Total taxes see `pricingStack.totalTaxes`.

isTaxable.description: Flag indicating whether this product is taxable or not. When `tax` is set to a `non-zero` amount then `isTaxable` is automatically set to true. In the case that zero or no `tax` is provided and `isTaxable` is `true`, the `tax` is calculated and included in the deal.

referenceId.title: Product Reference ID
referenceId.description: Product identifier used to reference a product within a DMS.

disclaimer.description: Disclaimer for the rebate. Displayed as a tooltip next to each rebate line item.

isDiscount.description: When `true` the `amount` is included in `discounts` instead of as a rebate line item. This can also affect the tax calculation (unless tax is submitted).

isQualifiedOffer.description: Indicates that the rebate is only available under certain conditions. For example special rebates for students or military.

name.description: Description of the rebate to be shown to the customer.

ProgramId.description: Unique identifier for the rebate program. When submitting a rebate with isQualifiedOffer as `true` the programId is required.

isPrivateOffer.description: Indicates that the rebate is a private offer for the applicant.

schemas-referenceId.description: Partner's unique identifier for each credit application. When provided, the loan application previously created for the given `referenceId` is returned instead of creating a new one.

SimulateEnvironment.title: Environment
SimulateEnvironment.description: Use `LENDER_TEST` to test End to End with R1/DT Lender Test Environment. Use `AUTOFI_TEST` to test with the AutoFi Test Environment (requires an array of `decisions` to be simulated). Defaults to `AUTOFI_TEST`.

SimulatedDecisionState.title: Decision State
SimulatedDecisionState.description: The lender response to return for the simulated decision

delay.description: Specify how long it should take for this simulated decision to return in milliseconds.

lender.description:
The lender that decision should be simulated for.
These are the lender codes available to use:
  - ALLY 
  - BOFA 
  - CHASE 
  - EXETER 
  - FIFS  
  - FMCC 
  - GLS 
  - GMFL 
  - HBAN 
  - LAFSNC 
  - RBC 
  - SANT 
  - SCF 
  - SETF 
  - TRICOR 
  - VROOM 
  - WEST

middleman.description: The middleman that the decision should be simulated from.

SimulateInput.title: Simulate
SimulateInput.description:
Request a test response from one or more lenders.
When omitted, the loan application is handled according to the default rules defined for the environment.
In uat, the AutoFi Test Environment is used and approvals are returned for all lenders.
In production, the loan application is submitted to R1/DT for `live` decisioning.

schemas-tax.description: The total taxes to be applied (should not include F&I Product taxes).

amount.description: The difference between the value of the vehicle and payoff amount i.e. `bookValue` - `payoff`.

bookValue.description: _Deprecated - The estimated market value of the vehicle. If submitted, this field is ignored._

leaseAnnualMiles.description: _Required if terminatingLease is true._ Miles a leased vehicle can be driven annually before the penalty is triggered.

leaseMonthlyPayment.description: _Required if `terminatingLease` is true._ Monthly payment for leased vehicle.

leaseNumRemainingPayments.description: _Required if `terminatingLease` is true._ How many months are left until the lease terms are fulfilled.

leasePenaltyPerExcessMile.description: _Required if `terminatingLease` is true._ Penalty for driving more than leaseAnnualMiles per year. Calculated on a per mile basis.

leaseTerm.description: _Required if `terminatingLease` is true._ Length of lease term in months.

mileage.description: Number of miles (US) or km (Canada) on vehicle.

payoff.description: The payoff amount the customer needs to pay to satisfy the terms of their vehicle loan.

terminatingLease.description: Determines whether the trade-in is a leased vehicle.

vin.description: Trade-in vehicle Identification Number. Must be 17 alphanumeric characters.

financeCompany.description: The finance company (lienholder) on the trade-in.

invoice.description: The initial price for the vehicle from the manufacturer. _Must be a positive number when `age` is `NEW`._

mileage.description: Number of miles (US) or km (Canada) on vehicle. _Required if `age` is `USED` or `CPO`._

modelCode.description: The code for the model provided by the manufacturer. This field is optional but recommended for new vehicles since it improves accuracy, e.g. determining the correct rebates.

msrp.description: Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price. _Required if `age` is `NEW`._

stockNumber.description: Vehicle stock number in dealer's inventory. Displayed in customer profile page in AutoFi Dealer Portal.

vin.description: Vehicle Identification Number. Must be 17 alphanumeric characters.

photoUrl.description: A valid URL to be used for showing the vehicle within the offer experience and customer profile page in AutoFi Dealer Portal.

fuelType.description: Fuel type used by the vehicle engine.

ConsumerUrlSchema.title: Consumer URL
ConsumerUrlSchema.description: URL to the consumer experience. The url expires 30 days after creation.

agentUrl.description: URL to the agent experience. This URL is not intended for the customer, but for the customer service agent. Please contact your AutoFi rep for configuration and further details of this field. Note: This field is only active when a referenceId is associated with the loan application. See Create Loan Application.

customerProfile.description: URL to the customer's profile in AutoFi Dealer Portal. Used by sales or customer support team.

loanApplicationId.description: The unique identifier for the loan application created by the request.

referenceId.description: Partner's unique identifier for each credit application. Same `referenceId` as was provided to AutoFi.

ValidationError.description:
Array of validation input errors found in the payload:
  - Required field not provided
  - Field can not be null
  - Field must be an object
  - Field is not a defined field
  - Field is invalid

FeeCode.description: Default is `OTHER`. Note: The `SHIPPING_FEE` is added to the vehicle's sales price when submitted to the middleman.

FeeName.description: The name of the fee. This fee varies per application and is different from dealer fees that are constant across all applications.

FeePlacement.description: `GROSS_CAP` means that the fee will be added to the Gross Capitalization Cost of the lease. `DUE_AT_SIGNING` means that the fee will be added to the Due at Signing Calculation and thus deducted from the down payment.

TaxAmount.description:
Total amount for this tax.  
**Note**: For product specific taxes see `selectedProducts.tax`.  
For Total taxes see `pricingStack.totalTaxes`.

TaxName.description:
The name of the tax.  
**Note**: if "Total Taxes" value is received, it is the total tax amount for the vehicle. Does not include product taxes.

TaxableAmount.description: Taxable amount.

TaxLineItems.description: The breakdown of the tax amount by jurisdiction. Each tax line item contains the tax rate and corresponding amount for each jurisdiction or tax authority.

jurisdiction.description: The jurisdiction responsible for the tax line item.

tax.description: Tax rate and amount calculated for the jurisdiction.

TaxPlacement.description: `CAPITALIZED` means that the tax will be added to the Gross Capitalization Cost of the lease. `DUE_AT_SIGNING` means that the tax will be added to the Due at Signing Calculation and thus deducted from the down payment. `BIWEEKLY` and `MONTHLY` taxes are taxes applied to the biweekly or monthly payments.

comments.description: List of raw lender comments returned via the middleman.

error.description: Avaliable when the status of the decision is `ERROR`

message.description: Message of the error that occurred when getting the decision.

isAccepted.description: This flag is `true` when the decision has been accepted by the customer.

dealerDiscountFee.description: Fee charged by the lender to the dealer for underwriting certain loan applications.

raw.description: Raw stipulations as are sent by lenders.

items.example: DOB MISMATCH ON BUREAU. PROOF OF DOB REQUIRED; DL OR OTHER GOVERNMENT ISSUED ID WITH PHOTO AND DOBS

normalized.description: Normalized from `raw` stipulations into a user friendly format. The number of `normalized` stipulations may not match the number of `raw` ones.

items.example: Applicant will need to show a valid government issued photo ID card for date of birth verification

PartialBasePricingStack.description: Fields in common for FINANCE and LEASE.

termMonths.description: Duration of the contract in months.

totalProducts.description: Total amount of all products including taxes.

isDiscount.description: When `true` the `amount` is included in `discounts` instead of as a rebate line item. This can also affect the tax calculation.

isPrivateOffer.description: Indicates that the rebate is a private offer for the applicant.

isQualifiedOffer.description: Indicates that the rebate is only available under certain conditions. For example special rebates for students or military.

name.description: Description of the rebate to be shown to the customer.

programId.description: Unique identifier for the rebate program.

BasePricingStack.description: Fields in common for FINANCE and LEASE.

dealerDiscountFee.description: Fee charged by the lender to the dealer for underwriting certain loan applications.

lenderName.description: Lender name for the accepted offer.

rebates.description: List of applied rebates. Note: they will only be returned after an offer has been selected.

tradeInAmount.description: The difference between the value of the trade-in vehicle and its payoff amount. Will always be 0 if the `isApplied` field of the trade-in vehicle is `false`.

FinancePricingStack.title: Finance
FinancePricingStack.description: This fields are only applicable to `FINANCE`.

downPayment.description: Amount the consumer is putting down towards the vehicle.

financeCharge.description: Finance charge calculated based on the `amountFinanced`, `apr` and `termMonths`.

taxItems.description: Tax items have now been `deprecated` in favor of the standardized `appliedTaxes` field.

amountFinanced.description: Total amount financed for the vehicle.

termMonths.description: Duration of the `FINANCE` contract in months.

totalTaxes.description:
Total amount of all vehicle and products taxes.  
**Notes:** For vehicle specific taxes see `appliedTaxes.amount`.  
For product specific taxes see `selectedProducts.tax`.

downPayment.description: Cash applied to the capitalized costs.

rebates.description: Rebates applied to the capitalized costs.

tradeIn.description: Trade-in applied to the capitalized costs.

appliedToSigning.description: Breakdown of costs applied at signing.

TaxItemsLease.description: Tax items applied to estimated lease payment calculation.

LeasePricingStack.title: Lease
LeasePricingStack.description: This fields are only applicable to `LEASE`.

annualMileage.description: Miles or km associated with the offer.

cashAppliedToCap.description: Cash Applied to the Capitalized Cost.

capReduction.description: Capitalized Cost Reduction. The sum of the cash, rebates and trade in.  This will be subtracted from the Gross Capitalization Cost.

depreciation.description: The amount of the vehicle will depreciate over the life of the term.

grossCap.description: Gross Capitalization Cost.  The total amount that will be applied to the loan.

leaseCharge.description: The lease charge is an interest applied to the total financing of the vehicle.

moneyFactor.description: The money factor is the financing charge a person will pay on a lease.

residualPercentage.description: Value of the vehicle at the end of the term expressed as a percentage of the sale price.

tags.name: Authorization
tags.description:
To authorize requests to the AutoFi API you will need an `Access Token` (JWT).

Requesting an `Access Token` requires authentication credentials which you can retrieve from the AutoFi admin panel (coming soon).

Once you have your `Access Token` you pass it in along in the authorization HTTP header like this:
```
curl -X GET "https://api-uat.autofi.com/v1/loan-application/abcde" \
-H "Authorization: Bearer 714552c6148e1617aeab526d0606184b94a80ec048fc09894ff1a72b740c5f19"
```
Generally, all API endpoints require token authorization, except where noted otherwise (the endpoint description will be lacking the Authorization requirement).
